title: Exactly what I wanted
body:
I was looking for a habit app with a calendar view and widgets. I tried a couple of them on the App Store and hated them immediately. They usually ask 20 questions just to get started, and then I quickly realized they weren’t what I was looking for.

Finally, I found this app. Huge thanks to the developer!!! It’s straightforward, easy to use, and does exactly what I wanted without all the unnecessary stuff. 🙌

author: Enfascination

title: So far so good
body: Just set myself up with about 8 habits.  I lose interest in things if they’re too complicated when I’m setting myself up for ease.  This was pleasantly straight forward. Will use this for a while for my morning routine and see how it goes.  Thank you for the simplicity!✨💖✨
author: Fawnomenal

title: Simple & nice
body: Very simple looking and easy to use, no ads or unnecessary features
author: microwavedbagel

title: Free and has widgets
body: Title explains why I like it. I have not found others that have both. One feature I would like to see is the calendar progress tracker, but instead of only 1 habit you could see up to 4 at once and have each habit take up 1/4 of the box. Or maybe the wider widget but make it so you have several habits stacked on top of each other (imagine a table with the date on the top and the habit on the side). What I am trying to say is I would like to be able to see the progress of multiple habits from my Home Screen without using multiple widgets. Great app.
author: BlackWolf22.

title: Love it
body: Great app, helps motivate me to be productive. I just wish there were more task icons. For example: News article/ Newspaper, Languages (Spanish & Chinese), Broom, Custom (choose your own emoji). Thanks!

title: Love this App!
body: I’m tracking no alcohol, no peanut butter, daily crunches… it’s fun and helpful to see success. I love the heat map and other views! Thank you!
author: LauraMarieRutkow

title: Providing Noticeable Feedback
body: The menu bar at the bottom blocks views if you have 9+ habits it’s hard to see the last habit because of the menu bar blocking the view. I’m not tracking anything crazy. Waking up without a phone, stretch, workout, skincare, journal, play game, drink water, sleep 8 hours, walk, & vitamins c intake. Backlogging data manually is a little hard because every time I left the app to look at my data in screenshots the calendar of each habit would disappear (not the data). I did it albeit the fact it took a lot of time. The look and feel of the app is great. Simple seamless. I love each view option. Just some minor drawbacks.
